map.偏头痛失能程度评估问卷(MIDAS)，评估过去3个月内头痛对工作、学习和日常生活: Migraine Disability Assessment Questionnaire (MIDAS), assesses headache impact on work, study and daily life over the past 3 months
map.MIDAS 偏头痛失能评估 = 5 个问题（工作日/家务/社交/娱乐等缺失天数）: MIDAS migraine disability = sum of 5 questions (days missed or reduced in work/housework/social/leisure etc.); ≤5 Grade I minimal, ≤10 II mild, ≤20 III moderate, >20 IV severe disability.
map.过去3个月内，因头痛导致以下天数缺失或减少：: Over the past 3 months, days missed or reduced due to headache:
map.1. 因头痛导致工作/学习缺勤的天数: 1. Days missed from work/school due to headache
map.2. 因头痛导致工作/学习效率减半的天数: 2. Days with halved productivity at work/school due to headache
map.3. 因头痛导致家务无法完成的天数: 3. Days unable to complete housework due to headache
map.4. 因头痛导致家务效率减半的天数: 4. Days with halved housework efficiency due to headache
map.5. 因头痛导致错过家庭/社交/休闲活动的天数: 5. Days missing family/social/leisure activities due to headache
map.补充信息（不计入MIDAS总分，供参考）: Supplementary information (not counted in MIDAS total, for reference)
map.A. 过去3个月内头痛发作的频率（次）: A. Headache attack frequency over past 3 months (times)
map.MIDAS是国际公认的头痛失能评估工具，用于偏头痛严重程度分层和治疗决策。III: MIDAS is an internationally recognized headache disability assessment tool, used for migraine severity stratification and treatment decisions. Grade III-IV patients should start preventive treatment (e.g. beta-blockers, calcium channel blockers, anti-epileptics, CGRP monoclonal antibodies). A MIDAS score change ≥3 days is clinically meaningful improvement. Recommend re-assessment at each follow-up.
map.偏头痛相关功能受损天数合计。: Sum of migraine-related days of functional impairment.
map.5 问合计 12 天（误工 5+家务 4+社交 3）：重度失能（11~15），建: 5 questions sum to 12 days (5 work loss + 4 housework + 3 social): severe disability (11~15), recommend visiting for prevention.
map.合计 4 天：轻度（≤5），注意发作频率。: Total 4 days: mild (≤5), watch attack frequency.
map.二者为同一 MIDAS 量表的不同实现，算法一致。: The two are different implementations of the same MIDAS scale, with consistent algorithm.
map.MIDAS头痛失能评估器，基于偏头痛失能程度评估问卷(Migraine Disa: MIDAS headache disability assessor, based on the Migraine Disability Assessment questionnaire, assesses the degree of headache impact on daily work and life. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
